verdicts.reason: A reflows the headline to four large lines, keeps the original look and puts the CTA right under it, so it fills the portrait canvas well. Its only flaw is that the group sits low: about 170px of space at the top against about 50px under the CTA. B squeezes the headline into two undersized lines that nearly touch the side edges (about 40px margins) and leaves a disconnected gap above the CTA.
